verdict.rationale: Sandboxing is a fair axis for a coding agent, but the pack has no first-party documentation of Gemini CLI running code, tools, or network access inside a sandbox. The only mention of a 'sandbox' (gemini-cli-comm-9) describes a Go binary in a thread about the tool's replacement, while gemini-cli-comm-4 says Gemini CLI is Node-based, so it cannot be credited here. The root-directory trust comment (gemini-cli-comm-17) is about a different control, not isolation.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can have the agent operate inside a sandbox when interacting with code, tools, and network resources
